name: Account Switch Notify Account Switch Complete V 02
definition: The AccountSwitchNotifyAccountSwitchComplete message is sent by the new account servicer to a central account switch servicer to signal that it has completed the account switch.

AccountSwitchDetails.name: Account Switch Details
AccountSwitchDetails.definition: Contains information about the account switch.||Usage: This element is used to communicate confirmation of the account switch.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
